Package com.egradx.files.storage

Interface EgradxBlobStore

All Known Implementing Classes:
EgradxLocalBlobStore, EgradxS3BlobStore
public interface EgradxBlobStore
Where a file's bytes live: local disk or an S3-compatible store. Keys are chosen by the library (org/{organizationId}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{fileId}). An application may provide its own implementation as a bean.
